Good Morning Lori,

We have extended your booking for one month in December as requested. Please find the booking confirmation along with the payment link.

Link: https://totalpay.ae/payment/20260813306a7d640e8c3ce

As you mentioned that you would also like to extend your stay for an additional 3 nights, from 30th December until 2nd January, the rate for the 3-night extension would be AED 35,000.

Kindly let us know if you would like to proceed with the additional 3-night extension.

Thank you.
